unit_attributes.statement: Visitors must register before entering the center, except overnight staff.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Governs visitors before entering the center, excluding overnight staff.

unit_attributes.statement: Visitors are not required to wear a badge.
Visitors must not carry metal tools inside the center, except maintenance workers performing repairs.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Governs visitors carrying metal tools inside the center, with an exception for maintenance workers performing repairs.

unit_attributes.statement: This policy does not prohibit visitors from carrying paper maps.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to visitors carrying paper maps under this policy.

unit_attributes.statement: Other building policies may impose additional restrictions.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to other building policies regarding restrictions.

unit_attributes.statement: Overnight staff are exempt from the duty to register before entering the center.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to overnight staff regarding the registration duty in paragraph a.

unit_attributes.statement: Maintenance workers performing repairs are exempt from the prohibition against carrying metal tools inside the center.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to maintenance workers while performing repairs regarding the metal-tool prohibition in paragraph c.

unit_attributes.statement: Maintenance workers may carry metal tools while performing repairs.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to maintenance workers while performing repairs.

unit_attributes.statement: A delay may occur when the visitor desk is busy.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies when the visitor desk is busy.

unit_attributes.statement: Staff should record the arrival time of each visitor.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to staff with respect to each visitor.
